verdict.rationale: Foreloop turns an incoming user-feedback submission into an intention, where its agent proposes tasks. Once a person approves the task contract, a local Claude Code or Codex agent claims the task and opens a PR. So work does flow from a ticket-like report to an agent, but only through Foreloop's own submission and intention objects, with agents pulling approved tasks rather than being assigned one. missing for 10: starting from existing GitHub/Jira issues or other external trackers, explicitly assigning a ticket to a specific agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.
